prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Create Eide's fighting-game menu portrait, skin 1. Inputs 1 and 2 are his identity photographs: preserve this specific man's face closely, short black hair faded sides and slightly swept up top, warm medium tan skin, brown almond eyes, short shaped beard along jaw and chin, thin mustache, rounded broad face, muscular compact athletic physique, height 1.76m. Input 3 is exact outfit: dark navy long-sleeve button-up tucked into fitted navy trousers, black belt, brown leather shoes, blue employee lanyard and badge with no readable personal information, brown leather crossbody messenger bag with dark strap, wristwatch. Input 4 Bozo is ONLY rendering-style reference: polished realistic illustrated fighting-game key art with warm amber rim light on left and blue rim light on right, detailed skin and clothing. Do not copy Bozo face, glasses or magical hair. Eide in confident fighting guard fists raised, three-quarter body facing right, face visible to viewer, full body including shoes, all silhouette contained with generous margin. True transparent background, no floor, no colored backdrop, no halo, no text or logo. Main priority accurate likeness to identity photos and outfit. Normal human form only.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image 1, Eide's new menu portrait, changing ONLY outfit to skin 2 using image 2 clothing reference. Preserve exactly the same face, short jawline beard and mustache, warm tan skin, muscular athletic body, fighting guard, full-body framing and polished realistic illustrated game style with amber and blue rim lighting. Outfit: tan/beige baseball cap, loose caramel/tan sleeveless gym tank, charcoal athletic shorts ending above knee, black crew socks and black athletic sneakers (shoes are a reasonable completion of cropped reference). Gold wristwatch, fine chain necklace. Match reference visible black geometric/Polynesian-style tattoo sleeve and smaller tattoos on other arm; use image 3 to check tattoo distribution. No phone, no bag, no lanyard, no employee badge. Cap brim raised enough to see his face and eyes clearly. Exact same Eide likeness. Full figure all shoes included, centered with margin, true transparent background without colored glow behind him, no text, normal human form.

Use case: style-transfer. Create a two-skin fighter MODEL LOOK-APPROVAL sheet for Eide, a 1.76m muscular adult male. Image1 is Gut's sprite atlas: use ONLY its game model rendering style, dark crisp contour lines, hand drawn pixel-edged arcade sprite, restrained detailed cel shading, normal athletic human proportions, camera at side three-quarter angle facing RIGHT. Images2 and3 are Eide's menu portrait drafts: copy Eide's exact identity, face, short dark hair, jawline beard/mustache and clothes into this sprite art style, NOT Gut's face/glasses. Image4 provides real Eide facial reference. Exactly TWO full-body idle guard sprites in ONE ROW, evenly spaced in two equal cells, matching height and body proportions, soles on same baseline, generous margins, both legs clearly separated in a natural fighting stance, fists up, face visible in three-quarter profile. Left sprite skin1: navy long sleeve button-up tucked into navy trousers, black belt, brown dress shoes, wristwatch, blue employee lanyard blank ID, brown crossbody messenger bag. Right sprite skin2: beige cap (eyes visible), caramel tan sleeveless gym tank, charcoal shorts, black crew socks and black athletic sneakers, gold watch, geometric tattoo sleeve on near arm plus smaller tattoos on other arm. Preserve same person both outfits. Transparent background, no environment, no text, no title, no shadows, no duplicate poses, no attack or transformation. Deliver production-quality sprite concept in Gut's rendering style, not photorealistic, not chibi.
